# Splashplay

> Splashplay is a creative art studio in Barcelona offering unconventional painting experiences. This site allows visitors to learn about techniques, book sessions, and purchase gift cards. The platform supports Spanish, English, and Catalan.

## About

Splashplay is the best messy-play art studio in Barcelona, specializing in unconventional creative experiences like rage painting and pouring. Visitors use non-traditional techniques like pouring, spinning, boxing with paint, balloons, water guns, and dripping (Pollock-style) to create unique artwork.

Sessions are available for couples, families, friend groups, and individuals. The studio also hosts celebrations including birthday parties and special occasions.

Team-building events are available for groups of up to 10 people, tailored to the specific needs of companies. These sessions offer a unique way to strengthen team bonds through creative collaboration and stress-relieving activities.

## Key Pages

- [Home](/): Main landing page with techniques showcase, testimonials, pricing, and gallery
- [Couples](/couples): Romantic painting experience for two (€60-90, 1.5-2 hours)
- [Families](/family): Family-friendly sessions with children (€60-180, 1.5-2 hours)
- [Friends](/friends): Group sessions for 2-6 people (€90-180, 1.5-2 hours)
- [Gift Cards](/giftcard): Purchase gift cards for any experience

## Booking

- [Book Couples](/book/couples): Book a couples session
- [Book Family](/book/family): Book a family session
- [Book Friends](/book/friends): Book a friends group session
- [Book Individual](/book/individual): Book an individual session

## Languages

The site is available in three languages:
- Spanish (default): no URL prefix
- English: `/en` prefix
- Catalan: `/ca` prefix

- [English Home](/en): English version of the homepage
